prompt: Create a wide 16:9 anime-style music cover artwork set in outer space above the curved blue-and-white Earth. The main subject is 1 floating teenage girl with a moody expression, pale skin, short messy black hair with pink highlights, red eyes, and a pink X hair clip, wearing an oversized black T-shirt printed with a simple white cat face, black shorts or a short skirt, and bare legs. She is drifting diagonally across the frame while holding 1 mint-green electric bass guitar with a wooden neck and visible strings, angled from lower center to upper right. Add 1 fluffy white cat floating beside her on the right, eyes closed, tail raised, appearing weightless and serene. Include exactly 4 music-related objects: 1 bass guitar in her hands, 2 small square red-and-black portable speakers with circular red drivers floating at left and upper right, and 1 black computer keyboard with neon pink outlines floating at the bottom right. Use long looping pink audio cables that arc around the composition like orbital paths. The background is a starry black cosmos with a vivid colorful nebula cloud in hot pink, orange, purple, and blue stretching across the upper center, bright starbursts, tiny sparkles, small floating crystal fragments, and thin orbital lines. Lighting should be dramatic and cinematic with magenta rim light, cool blue Earth glow, high contrast shadows, clean cel-shaded anime rendering, detailed line art, glossy highlights on the guitar, and a dreamy melancholic J-pop album-cover atmosphere. No title text, no logo, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张 16:9 的宽屏动漫风格音乐封面艺术，背景设定在蓝色与白色弧形地球上方的外太空中。主体是一位漂浮的少女，表情忧郁，皮肤白皙，留着凌乱的短发（黑色头发配粉色挑染），红色眼睛，戴着粉色 X 型发夹，身穿一件超大号的 黑色 T 恤，上面印有简约的白色猫脸，下身穿着黑色短裤或短裙，光着双腿。她斜向漂浮在画面中，手中拿着一把薄荷绿色的电贝斯，琴颈为木质，琴弦清晰可见，从画面左下角延伸至右上角。在右侧添加一只漂浮的蓬松白猫，闭着眼睛，尾巴翘起，显得失重且宁静。包含 4 个与音乐相关的物体：她手中的 1 把贝斯，左侧和右上角各漂浮着 1 个带有圆形红色驱动单元的小型方形红黑配色便携音箱，以及右下角漂浮着 1 个带有霓虹粉色轮廓的黑色电脑键盘。使用长长的环绕粉色音频线，像轨道一样在构图中勾勒出弧线。背景是布满繁星的黑色宇宙，上方中心延伸着一片色彩鲜艳的星云，呈现出热粉色、橙色、紫色和蓝色，伴有明亮的星爆、细小的闪光、微小的漂浮水晶碎片和细长的轨道线。光影效果应具有戏剧性和电影感，带有洋红色轮廓光、冷蓝色地球辉光、高对比度阴影、干净的赛璐珞动漫渲染、精细的线条艺术、吉他上的光泽高光，以及梦幻忧郁的 J-pop 专辑封面氛围。无标题文字，无 Logo，无水印。
